card.name: Maple Valley dark and robust maple syrup
card.description: Organic dark and robust maple syrup from a Wisconsin cooperative. This is a place for pancakes, yes, but also oatmeal and a warm slice of cornbread.

meet_the_maker.name: Maple Valley
meet_the_maker.story: Not everything good has to come from down the road. Maple Valley is a cooperative with its bottling operation in Wisconsin, bringing organic maple syrup from its producers to the table. Dark and robust means a proper maple presence—on breakfast, in baking, or alongside something savory.
